node.statement: Constants-closing step: choose C_ch=1024 and kappa_ch=1/4. The guard C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_ch implies all smallness hypotheses in nodes 1.1-1.4, and their conclusions give every existence, uniqueness, membership, estimate, C^1-chart, and covering clause of node 1 with the advertised C_ch bounds and strict normal-derivative bound <1.
